Adolion: Night Courts
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
The Castle's Two Owners
At a castle where night never ends.
The gates open before anyone touches them, and in the great hall, under a moonlit night that never ends, a man and a woman are arguing.
Something is starting to stir.
About this story
You lead a C-rank party of the Aegis City Adventurers Guild, with Belle and Dalan at your side, and tonight's posting comes from the almoners of the Grand Temple: people are vanishing from the slums between midnight and dawn, and the watch will not go down there after dark. Expect gothic horror, long nights and strange company on the road. Bring your persona as the party's leader, a Guild adventurer who takes the jobs nobody else will.
Recently
You left The Long Night behind and moved into The Castle's Two Owners.
Open threads
The steward of Castle Dracul says he has been expecting the party — who he is, how he knew they were coming, and what he wants remain unknown.
Who is behind the Heresy and where its original has gone — the party's core mission — remains unanswered as they enter Castle Dracul.
Castle Dracul is in sight and the party must decide whether to enter despite Dalan's fear and the nightmare air around it.
Why the dead are drawn toward Castle Dracul and its road remains unexplained.
Dalan's terror of Castle Dracul and his plea to turn back — whether the party enters anyway remains to be seen.
The story so far
In the fog-bound town of Kelger Falls, Max Nightriver and his companions investigated the disappearances that had plagued the town since the first frost. Questioning a skeleton mending a net in the Aegis slums, Max learned that the dead no longer fished, that the bell rang for ships that never came, and that the north-east road was the only route ever tried. The party took a boat south into the sea to test whether the fog would release the town, but Zariah revealed the fog was bound to her and followed them.

Preparing the road ahead…

The bell tolled once more and stopped, and the fog poured inward across the square, swallowing the skeletons and the bone-crowned creature until the square was empty and the fog was gone. A cold grey sky appeared over Kelger Falls for the first time, and the town fell silent. Max Nightriver handed the closed book back to Zariah, told her to keep it shut and come with them, and led the party out along the road, which no longer led back to the square. They left the road to follow a river northeast, and Zariah, Belle, Fael, and Nyl walked with him through frost-covered land, debating the road's lies and the silence of the country. By the second night the river brought them to a cluster of low stone houses on no map, where nobody answered Max Nightriver's knock and the window light dimmed to nothing. Max Nightriver decided to turn back toward Aegis City for a week to resupply and rest Zariah, and though Zariah flinched and questioned whether the road would let them leave, she followed him south-west away from the distant bell, while the skeletal cat hissed at the castle silhouette behind them.
